chunks: So I swear by the Lord of the Easts and the Wests that We are certainly able
ai.seo_question: What does God swear by in Surah Al-Ma'arij to affirm His power of resurrection?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as a response to the disbelievers' skepticism regarding the resurrection, emphasizing that the One who controls the complex movements of the sun and moon possesses the power to reassemble human bodies. The oath by the 'rises and sets' highlights the precision of cosmic order as a sign of divine capability, reinforcing the theological concept of *Qadr* (divine power) over both the macrocosm and the microcosm of human existence.
